deals.deal: Mix & Match Menu: $4.99 half sandwiches, salads or soups
deals.desc: Pick two or more half-size soups, salads or sandwiches (Toasted Italiano, Fuji Apple Chicken and more) for $4.99 each, plus a free side.

deals.deal: Fresh Value Menu: $4.99 Sub of the Day, $3.99 Deli Faves & Protein Pockets
deals.desc: Subway's first-ever value menu offers a rotating $4.99 six-inch Sub of the Day plus $3.99 Deli Faves and Protein Pockets sandwiches nationwide.
Naf Naf Grill's biggest value menu yet: a full pita meal for $9.99, available in-store and on the app.

deals.deal: $7+ Meal Menu, including new Fish & Chips for $7.99
deals.desc: Rubio's standing value menu features meals from $7 to $10, headlined by the new Fish & Chips for just $7.99.

deals.deal: Delicious Duos: small entree, protein and a side from $9.95
deals.desc: Pair a small entree of any Noodles favorite with a protein and a side, served all day, starting at $9.95.

deals.deal: Sub of the Day: $4.99 six-inch sub
deals.desc: A different six-inch sub is featured at $4.99 every day at participating restaurants, part of Subway's new Fresh Value Menu; add chips and a drink for $2 more.

deals.deal: Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and drink for $7.99
deals.desc: A permanent value menu item: a mini bowl with chicken, sweet and spicy chicken or tofu, plus a value side and 12 oz drink for $7.99.
Drive-thru-only salads and wraps, including the Good Greens Salad and Wrap with chickpeas, Brussels sprouts and choice of chicken or tofu, start at $7.75.

A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market.

deals.deal: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
deals.desc: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $5
deals.desc: Every Wednesday in most Sprouts Farmers Market locations, select Oumi sushi rolls from the in-store sushi case are $5 each instead of the regular $7 to $10. Walk in and grab them: no coupon, app, or membership needed; participation and selection vary by store.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls, Typically $5
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox or Zenshi sushi counter (Kroger, Fred Meyer, Fry's, King Soopers, Smith's, QFC, Ralphs) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, at a flat promotional price, typically $5 (some divisions $6) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Nori Sushi Rolls for $6
deals.desc: Every Wednesday at participating Hy-Vee stores with a Nori Sushi counter, select rolls are $6 each (regularly about $8 to $10). A store-run promotion: price and selection vary by store, and no card or app is needed.

deals.deal: Sushi Wednesday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7
deals.desc: Every Wednesday, H-E-B stores with an in-store Sushiya counter sell select fresh rolls for $7 (regularly about $9 to $12). No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store and sells out by evening.

Every Wednesday, participating ShopRite stores sell select fresh sushi rolls (spicy crab, California and more) for $5.99, regularly $8 to $10. In-store only; ShopRite stores are independently owned, so selection and participation vary.
